reviews.x: Very easy to use with the only exception opening the clipper. Once opened the action is smooth, the cut is smooth, precise, and sharp. This clipper does not leave an edge that needs to be filed. Already ordered a second pair to keep around the house. Highly recommend.  You will not be sorry.

reviews.t: Best fingernail clippers I have ever tried.
reviews.x: Awesome clippers. Big for fingernails. Super sharp and lots of leverage. Super easy to hold. I also use on fishing line--half the time don't even have to close. Cut on touch. In storage position, the cutting surfaces are pretty close. When open, plenty big of opening for almost any nail. Crazy nice file, beyond anything imaginable on a clippers.

I really like these nail clippers. They dont work too well on children, since they are a bit big to go around their fingernails but worked great on adults. Also, they go down really easily and smoothly but cut well. They are so easy to push down that I thought they wouldn't cut well. But they are incredibly sharp and smooth.

reviews.t: Well made, expensive, but poor design.
reviews.x: I kept this nail clipper because it is very sharp, makes a clean cut on finger nails, looks good, comes in a handy storage cylinder, and has a fantastic nail file built into the handle.  What I DON'T like about it is that the jaws just don't open wide enough, which is a "first" for me.  If your finger nails are not perfectly flat (most aren't), you will have a devil of a time getting your finger nail between the jaws.  I literally have to work at it, and my finger nails are thinner than most.  I

All of my life, I've used the cheap fingernail cutters you buy in a drugstore. Some worked fine, but most didn't cut cleanly. Some cutters just sort of mashed through my nails unevenly rather than really cutting. I got into the habit of cutting my fingernails only after a shower, because my nails were a little softer then and I could get a cleaner cut. However, the new cutters are great! reviews.t: Nice packaging... too bad it was EMPTY!
reviews.x: Received quickly on order. Packaging was a small cardboard tube with a plastic molded insert on the inside inside of a clear sealed plastic bag. Apparently the insert is meant to hold the set of pricy clippers, but mine was completely empty.

I’m into the “senior years” and no longer have a lot of finger strength, especially in my left hand. It was so difficult to use my fingernail clippers to trim my right hand as I couldn’t apply enough pressure for the SNIP!  I was a bit hesitant to purchase these as they use the same concept as my old clippers. reviews.x: And here I thought all clippers were just clippers.  Nope!  I "accidentally" tossed a pair of old clippers and my hubby was devastated.  So I went on the search to replace them to avoid going to hell.  These clippers have redeemed me, thank the heavens.  I had no idea there were such differing clippers, but must admit after trying several brands that these were the best.  No tearing, splitting, or rough edges.  No need to file nails when finished cutting.  Easy use...ergonomic.  These will remai

When it comes to buy nail trimmers, I have bought many over the years and found that the single most important feature is sharpness. These are incredibly sharp and cut very cleanly. A very good value for the money comparable to any other Japanese or German cutlery.  It would be helpful if it included hey swing out nail file, and something to dig under the nail. Most high and trimmers do not include this.  Like most trimmers the size, it would be nice if there was more texture on the outside so t

reviews.t: Great Choice!  I’ll buy them again!
reviews.x: I love these clippers. They are sharp, consistent and slightly larger in my hand than typical store brands. The opening between blades is not ideal for thicker toe nails, but are perfect for finger nails. The file is unnecessary, but I’m sure it’s great for some. The fingernail clippers easily cut nails without straining to close. I will definitely buy more and try to find some toe nail clippers that are equally as wonderful.

reviews.t: The very best for my aging hands
reviews.x: I am 90 years old and most nail clippers tend to slip out of my fingers. These provide a firm grip, are very sharp and cut clean, without having to presoaking my hands in water. The file seems to be made of commercial diamond dust and really cuts fast. Quality is evident. Many of my family members have tried them and have ordered their own.
These are the best nail clippers I've ever bought. Nicely made & heavy duty. The no slip feature is really nice. I wish that was on the bottom too. I highly recommend.
Not quite as advertised. Hard to get into the sides of fingernail and leave a rough cut. Good leverage thought when nails are soft (right after a shower).

I have very hard, tough nails and trimming them has never been very easy. Cheap clippers work but I really have to use a lot of force to the point of them starting to bend. Cheap clippers leave my nails with sharp edges that have to be filed. These Mr Green clippers are amazing. I feel silly gushing over nail clippers but they cut through my hard nails like a hot knife through butter and don't require filing afterwards. They are a little more expensive than the cheap ones but well worth it to me

"Built in nail file" was laying next to clippers in package, stuck it back on and it is staying in place but has a weird glue residue on it that make it impossible to use. Clippers themselves cut nice...i dont know there is a difference in these and a 4 dollar pair though.

These nail clippers are built to last.  The hinge will not fall apart like cheaper clippers.  I was surprised that these cut through toenails just as easily as the fingernails.  The built in nail file is also a nice bonus.  I liked these so much I purchased a 2nd  set.

I've had so many disappointing clippers that cut all jagged or don't cut at all. This clipper is great. Cuts perfectly smooth and is very sharp. The Emery board is fantastic. I won't need to buy another pair unless these get lost and I would buy these again for sure.

Wonderful clippers! If you, like me, have bought cheapos off the register rack at Target and then regretted later as you tore and otherwise mutilated your fingernails- these are for you. Retains the edge and really well designed.Well worth the $!!

reviews.t: Best nail clippers I've ever owned!
reviews.x: These clippers are the best I have ever owned.  They are sharp and even cut my thick toenails with ease.  I am very satisfied with this product and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for the ultimate in nail clipping care.  Thank you.

Apparently I had no idea what really good fingernail clippers were like until I bought these. Mr. Green fingernail clippers are incredibly well made, sharp and easy to use. Made to last a lifetime and an excellent gift idea too.

It's rounded so it has to fit the shape of your nail. My nails don't fit it and so it cuts the nail in new moon-shaped pieces. Otherwise, it's sharp and looks like a solid product, well-made. Not returning due to the hassle....

This is not your standard nail clipper! When you hold it in your hand you can feel that it is higher quality than the standard ones. The cutting action is also smooth and sharp.  I think this nail clipper might outlast me!
This is well made in terms of the quality of the materials but the design isn't very functional. I find it difficult to use (so did my husband so we tossed it) and wouldn't recommend.
Way too small for my toenails, almost too small for my fingernails. Nice and sharp, though. And the built-in file is excellent. I’m a sixty-five year old woman.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clippers as very sharp and producing clean, precise cuts.
Many reviewers find the clippers easy to use with smooth action and requiring little pressure, which is especially helpful for weak or aging hands.
Several reviewers note the clippers are large, which works well for adult fingernails but is too big for children and not ideal for thicker toenails.
A few reviewers complain that the jaws do not open wide enough or are hard to get into the sides of the nail, leaving rough cuts.
Some reviewers report problems with the built-in nail file or with receiving an empty package.
